title: Unstoppable Wolf
candidateFloorDerivation: 4 starting Wolf cash values * 0.4x minimum * 2x minimum multiplier = 3.2x, using public rule descriptions that starting Wolves remain in feature, multiplier applies to all cash values, and Mega Collect gathers visible cash values.

defaultPublicConfigContext.warning: Overall hit frequency is not operator-bound Interwetten trigger probability and cannot be transferred as an exact trigger probability. It is used only as a public default-config context bound: a specific full-stack trigger cannot occur more often than all winning spins if every such feature trigger produces a positive feature result.

conclusion: The 3.2x guaranteed/candidate floor is not enough by itself to prove a profitable 4-of-5 cross-stake exercise. A defensible conditional expected Super Respin value materially above 3.2x, plus operator-bound last-reel full-stack probability and build-cost distribution, is still required.
remainingGates: Interwetten-bound probability of a full Wolf stack on the missing reel while at 4/5
Interwetten-bound conditional expected gross value of Super Respin, not merely payout floor
net cost distribution to build the 4/5 indicator state at low stake
